random_algorithm: Python random.Random(seed).choice, uniform six-way scene selection

candidate_pool.scene: A stranded last-tram passenger in a small mountain terminus straightening a wind-bent route map on a narrow bench while the snow-covered track remains visible through the open doorway.
A winter seed-swap organizer in an old glasshouse entrance salvaging a spilled tray of paper seed packets before the sliding door shuts against a snow gust.
A ceramic maker at a snowbound kiln-shed doorway nesting a freshly wrapped bowl into a delivery crate before stepping outside.
An observatory volunteer in the open dome entrance aligning a folded star chart on a low table while the telescope points through a gap toward the first clear winter sky.
A dawn ferry traveler inside a small timber ticket shelter bracing a folded harbor chart on the counter while a fogged window reveals the arriving ferry and snow.
A winter orchard caretaker at a potting-shed threshold tying a paper label to a bare branch laid across the workbench after bringing it in from the snow.

chosen.scene: A winter orchard caretaker at a potting-shed threshold tying a paper label to a bare branch laid across the workbench after bringing it in from the snow.

authorial_scope: knit surface structure and pattern, wearer-owned layered garment relations
planned_wardrobe: Oatmeal cable-knit cardigan open over a pine-green Fair Isle wool vest, a white cotton shirt as the innermost layer; long charcoal rib-knit scarf with its loop behind the neck and both ends down the outer sides; dark wool trousers. Raised interlacing cable ridges, separate narrow rib trims, repeated small geometric colorwork bands, visible shirt collar/cuffs/hem with uninterrupted nested layer boundaries.
ownership: All scene, styling, story, camera and pose details here are agent-owned choices. The requester asks for winter-fashion generation tests and use of the supplied appearance reference; these choices are not requester definitions or locks.
reference_use: Visible face/hair guide only: dark short bob, fine wispy bangs, brown eyes, softly rounded cheeks and natural rose lips. Outfit/body/crop in the reference do not bind the new scene. Exact same-person identity is not established.

independent_observation_targets.goal: Cardigan knit loops form raised interlacing cable ridges with recessed channels, relief visible across torso and sleeves.
The cardigan edge and cuffs have separate narrow parallel rib columns; rib trim stays distinguishable from cable field.
The pine-green vest has repeated small geometric colorwork bands visibly made of stitches, bound to that vest rather than printed on the cardigan.
White shirt lies beneath vest and cardigan; collar, cuffs, and a narrow hem emerge from the correct openings and are continuous with the inner layer.
Charcoal scarf belongs around the same neck, its knit rib columns visible, and both ends lie along the outer sides leaving vest chest bands readable.
The selected visible action has owner-connected arms and hands, a stable supporting surface, target contact and visible result.

initial_gates: These independent observation targets are authored test goals. Actual adopted opt-in and embodiment hard gates will be evaluated separately after retrieval and generation.
